subject: MATHEMATICS
principles: Assimilation Compiler may execute only from a JOIN_READY AssimilationDemand.
Every assimilation obligation must be transformed into learner-facing cognitive structure before manuscript writing.
Learning atoms are not source claims; they are pedagogical decompositions bound to source-backed obligations.
Prerequisite edges must form an acyclic graph and may not point to undeclared atoms.
Representation is a governed decision: requirement -> at least two candidates -> admissibility -> explicit selection.
Equation assimilation must state meaning, symbol bridges and validity conditions rather than present naked formulae.
Unknown or developing learner capability requires explicit support fading; UNKNOWN is not weakness.
Competitive-exam purpose requires transfer while preserving required foundations.
Hard owner constraints must be satisfied before the plan can be released.
AssimilationPlan is a reasoning contract, not textbook prose.
